description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Downward Dog”A tranquil coastal escape tucked away in Seacrest West, this charming 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home sleeps 11 guests and is the perfect retreat for families, friends, and your furry companions. With a private pool, screened-in porch, and stylish indoor/outdoor living areas, every detail is designed to help you unwind in coastal comfort. Just a short 3-minute stroll to the private beach access and a quick bike ride to Alys or Rosemary Beach, “Downward Dog” delivers luxury, leisure, and location in perfect harmony. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Seacrest West Location — Peaceful neighborhood with quick beach accessPrivate, Seasonally Heated Pool — Fenced-in yard with outdoor shower, loungers, & gas grillScreened-In Back Porch — The perfect place to sip your morning coffee or evening cocktailsAl Fresco Dining — Pool deck seating for 4 under string lightsChef’s Kitchen — Stainless steel appliances, bar seating & open layoutSleeps 11 — Includes a King over King bunk + Twin over Queen bunkPet Friendly — Bring your four-legged friend along for the adventure4 Bikes Included — Explore nearby Alys, Rosemary, & The Big Chill*** LIVING AREA ***Gather, relax, and recharge in this thoughtfully designed living space with a cozy sectional, wall-mounted flat-screen TV, and easy access to the screened-in porch and pool deck. A wet bar near the back door makes outdoor entertaining effortless.Comfy sectional sofa perfect for lounging after a beach dayLarge flat-screen TV for movie nights or rainy-day entertainmentDouble doors lead to screened-in porch and private poolWet bar with sink near the pool deck—great for mixing poolside drinks*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you're preparing fresh seafood or morning pancakes, the chef’s kitchen is fully stocked and effortlessly functional. With bar seating for 3 and a dining table for 5, mealtimes are a breeze.Stainless steel appliances and generous counter spaceBar seating for 3 at the central islandDining table with seating for 5 in the open-concept layoutPlenty of natural light and quick access to the screened porch for al fresco moments*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Half Bath: Conveniently located off the living areaPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, direct access to pool deck, en-suite with dual vanities & walk-in shower2nd Floor:King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, access to 2 balconies, en-suite with single vanity, clawfoot tub & showerBunk Room: Custom setup with 1 King-over-King bunk + 1 Twin-over-Queen bunk, flat-screen TV, en-suite with dual vanities & walk-in showerWork Station: Dedicated desk space on the upstairs landing, perfect for remote work*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***The private backyard is a haven for relaxation and play. Lounge by the seasonally heated pool, rinse off under the outdoor shower, or grill dinner beneath twinkling string lights as your four-legged friend enjoys the fresh air and open space.Private pool (seasonally heated Sept. 1 – April 30) with sun loungersAl fresco dining for 4 on the poolside deckGas grill for cookouts under ambient string lightsOutdoor shower for rinsing off after beach or pool timeFully fenced-in yard—perfect for children and petsScreened-in back porch for shaded morning coffee or evening wine*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked in laid-back Seacrest West but just minutes from the action, “Downward Dog” offers the best of both worlds—quiet retreat and quick access to the area’s top attractions.3-minute walk to private beach access5-minute bike ride to Alys Beach’s dining & architecture5-minute drive to The Big Chill 30A for live music & family entertainment5-minute drive to shops & restaurants in Seacrest and Rosemary Beach*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel insurance is not included but may be purchased at checkout or separatelyWe do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool heated seasonally (Sept. 1 - April 30)Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys BeachPlease note there is active construction taking place across the street. We do not have a completion date at this time.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
